questions.stem: DevOps focuses on development by software developers, quality and operations. What does DataOps focus on?
options: Source and target integrations, data transformation by data engineers, data quality and security
questions.explanation: DataOps concentrates on integrating sources and targets, the data transformation done by data engineers, and data quality and security.

questions.stem: While DevOps ensures there is no hindrance to a high-quality development cycle, what does DataOps ensure end users receive?
options: High-quality, trusted, ready-to-use data and actionable KPIs
questions.explanation: DataOps makes sure end users get high-quality, trusted, ready-to-use data and actionable KPIs.

questions.stem: DevOps aligns IT, operations and business team members to SPEED UP the process after every sprint. What does DataOps align roles and responsibilities for?
questions.explanation: DataOps aligns the roles and responsibilities of IT, development and business team members for faster collaborative work across teams.

questions.stem: DevOps automates server management, version control, configuration, testing and release management. Which activities does DataOps make sure are automated?
options: Data acquisition, integration, metadata management, self-service, data governance and cross-cloud operation
questions.explanation: DataOps ensures data acquisition, integration, metadata management, self-service, data governance and cross-cloud activities all work in an automated fashion.

questions.stem: DevOps works with stakeholders for real-time feedback after every sprint. How is DataOps' optimisation with stakeholders characterised?
options: Result-oriented optimisation, drawing regular insights from new data flowing in
questions.explanation: DevOps optimisation is feedback-oriented, whereas DataOps is result-oriented, drawing insights from new data arriving in real time or in batch.

questions.stem: DevOps goes for regular implementations for quick recovery from failures in agile mode. What does DataOps aim to fix quickly through regular implementations?
options: Data quality issues and minimum metadata discovery
questions.explanation: DataOps uses regular implementations to quickly fix data quality problems and improve metadata discovery in agile mode.

questions.stem: In the DevOps workflow of builds, codes, unit test, performance, SIT, UAT, PROD deployment and business value, which step comes immediately after UAT?
questions.explanation: After UAT the DevOps workflow moves to PROD deployment, and then to business value.

questions.stem: Which sequence describes the DataOps workflow?
options: Codes, unit test, SIT, UAT, business value
Data pipelining, transformations, data look and feel, business value
questions.explanation: DataOps focuses on data: data pipelining, transformations, data look and feel, and finally business value.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a DataOps concern rather than a DevOps concern?
questions.explanation: Metadata management is one of the things DataOps automates, whereas servers, version control, configuration and release management belong to DevOps.

questions.stem: What is the final outcome that both the DevOps and DataOps workflows lead to?
questions.explanation: Both workflows, whether starting from what developers build or from data pipelining, end in business value.
